sql_template: SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM graphrag.projects WHERE COALESCE(status, '') NOT IN ('deleted', 'archived')), 0), (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT category) FROM graphrag.graphrag_sources WHERE category IS NOT NULL))::int AS active_project_count

SELECT name, role_id, email 
FROM graphrag.admin_users 
WHERE approval_status = 'approved' 
LIMIT 10;
